purpose: Concrete existing assertion-to-obligation design inputs for independent ScopePlan review and next adapter implementation.

interpretation.mapping_status: A source assertion or compared observation exists; linkage is a partial reviewer finding, never clause sufficiency.
interpretation.absence: An unmapped ID is not a product failure and is not necessarily absent from all repository tests; it remains an explicit decomposition task.
interpretation.reference: Reference assertions may inform independent adapter design. Their observations keep authored_reference_qualification purpose and fixed source.
interpretation.portable: Portable/generic definitions still need candidate suitability, exact source/ordered-suite/evaluator/runtime/environment/limits/seed/protocol/purpose bindings and fresh required observations.
interpretation.selectors: JSON pointers identify returned candidate observations; python/javascript source anchors identify existing assertion code, not exported executable Registry selectors. A whole-vector selector requires finer clause decomposition where indicated.
interpretation.v2: All v2 application remains unapproved. Unchanged source values can inform an explicit compatibility review; new/changed clauses and amendments do not inherit v1 acceptance.
interpretation.gaps: 188 retained gap notes are design inputs. New reference selectors can inform their dispositions; no old gap count is treated as a current product verdict.
interpretation.counts: Partial-link counts describe this mapping resource only, not semantic coverage percentages.

rows: Fresh pinned environment starts application and completes declared workflows with no undeclared installed dependencies.
Confirm product dependency/entrypoint contract and absence of provider/account/network requirement; sandbox containment alone does not prove dependency independence.
Exact maximum and one-over UTF-8 key/segment lengths, including multibyte characters.
Representative each prohibited lexical class and empty/nonstring key, at real v0 import plus namespaced intake.
Regular nested source beneath configured root.
Root, ancestor and leaf symlink; nonregular leaf; unavailable path; validate unchanged catalog/content graph.
Direct v0 importer malformed UTF-8 and unsupported/nonregular files through actual import interface; do not infer from ZIP parser failure.
Direct file exact/over byte bound with multibyte input; catalog reaches exact count and rejects additional distinct source while allowing unchanged replay.
Capacity failures preserve prior catalog/blobs and return the public error convention.
Persisted blob/content-graph absence of new/orphan writes is not observed by document listings; prospectively declare a trustworthy storage audit observation.
Representative failing direct-import and multi-entry transaction with preexisting shared content.
Same relative input under two independently configured absolute roots yields identical published IDs.
Shared blob-ID equality does not itself count physical blob rows; physical sharing belongs to storage audit contract.
Reuse exact PUB-02 execution for semantic behavior; one actual CLI/API replay sequence verifies parser/persistence equivalence.
No extra blob/catalog rows needs published storage audit or equivalent source-bound observation.
Source-only, text-only and delimiter-spanning literal match; empty query; representative casefold expansion and regex metacharacters as literal text.
Near-miss query returns empty set without changing state.
Mixed-case/non-ASCII source ordering and search subset across multiple pages.
Offset at and beyond result count; page joins equal unsliced order; total remains full matching count.
Empty and exact/over character bound, multibyte text proving characters rather than bytes; offset zero/large, limits 1/100.
Negative offset, zero/over limit, booleans for both, noninteger structured inputs and malformed transport numbers.
Actual HTTP/CLI show and paginated list/search shape equivalence; reuse existing public semantic assertions.
Missing and mixed-valid/missing selected IDs, malformed selection shape, explicit empty selection.

Explicit loopback listener binding evidence; reaching private loopback alone does not prove no wildcard bind.
Persist inherited-import/query data across independent CLI/server invocations.
Exact HTTP inherited route matrix including POST import/selected export, query/pagination and show; assert status/content-type/body rather than infer from shared Service.
Inherited not_found/source_changed and unsupported route; malformed/repeated/unrecognized query representations according to prospectively frozen parser contract; missing/extra inherited POST fields.
Exact body byte bound and one over with valid structured body; multibyte payload.
